rita: Heads up — onboarding with the .NET sample app hit a parity issue. The UI lists org users by calling a paginated admin endpoint. REST returns pages fine, but the dotnet SDK only returns the first page and there's no helper to iterate. Sampleapp expects an `IAsyncEnumerable<User>` and our usage gets stuck with partial list.

omar: which endpoint exactly? `GET /v1/admin/users` with `?page_size=50&page_token=...`?

rita: yes. curl + page_token works:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/users?page_size=50"
```
returns `next_page_token` and items. In the SDK call `client.Admin.Users.ListAsync(pageSize:50)` we only get the first response (no `NextPageToken` exposed).

sdk-ci-bot: opened issue DOTNET-119: admin/users pagination missing iterator. https://git.redwood/dev/dotnet-sdk/issues/119 :white_check_mark:

lee: looks like the generated bindings map the response to `UserListResponse` but the generator didn't add an iterator extension because the response schema uses `oneOf` for items vs errors. Codegen conservative behavior skipped the helper. We can add a manual extension method `ListAllAsync()` returning `IAsyncEnumerable<User>` as a quick fix.

rita: that would be great. Also noticed another annoying difference: the .NET HttpClient layer canonicalizes header names to lowercase when building HttpRequestMessage.Headers. On our on-prem proxy a plugin matches `Authorization` header case-sensitively and fails when lowercase. So devs see 401s intermittently based on router.

omar: we saw that too in a separate bug. For .NET specifically, HttpRequestMessage.Headers is a typed collection and casing is generally preserved, but our wrapper stringifies and lowercases keys. We should stop that.

docs-bot: added labels: sdk/dotnet, bug, onboarding, pagination, headers. Assigned to @omar.

lee: plan: 1) add `ListAllAsync()` helper in dotnet SDK as compatibility shim; 2) update codegen to emit iterators for paginated responses even when `oneOf` is present (or at least warn); 3) preserve header casing in transport; 4) add integration test that lists users against staging proxy and asserts full set is returned without auth 401s.

omar: ETA: I'll open a patch PR tonight. Patch release target tomorrow after CI. I'll also add a small sampleapp fallback: if iterator missing, use REST fallback with `next_page_token` loop to avoid blocking new users. I'll put the snippet in sampleapp README and reference the issue.

rita: thanks! this blocked onboarding for a customer demo. Appreciate the quick action. :pray:
